Heading: Partner with Tedwren
Intro: If you already help subcontractors run a tighter operation, you can refer them to Tedwren and earn on the work you send our way. Every partner is reviewed and approved by us first — there's no instant sign-up.
ExclusionStatement: This programme is for advisers and suppliers to subcontractors — not for anyone who controls or influences access to a site. If you manage a gate, run inductions, or decide who gets on site, you're not eligible, and we'll decline the application. The partner programme is never a route to site access.

HowItWorks.Heading: Apply
HowItWorks.Body: Tell us who you are, how you work with subcontractors, and your relationship to any site or contractor.

HowItWorks.Heading: We review
HowItWorks.Body: A person reviews every application. Nothing activates until we've approved you — no referral links, no dashboard.

HowItWorks.Heading: Refer and earn
HowItWorks.Body: Once approved, you get a unique referral code and a dashboard. Refer subcontractors and track what you've earned.

CommissionTerms: 20% of a referred subcontractor's first-year revenue.
Paid after the customer's funds have cleared.
Subject to a 90-day clawback if the customer cancels or reverses.
Referrals are attributed to your code even if the sign-up isn't in the same browsing session.
MetaDescription: Refer subcontractors to Tedwren and earn 20% of first-year revenue. Approval-gated — reviewed by a person, and never a route to site access.
